summary: A novel subcommand whose leaf name collides with another command must live in a <parent>_<leaf>.go file, because novel commands are invisible to static command resolution.
reason: verify-skill walks literal rootCmd.AddCommand(...) calls to map a command path to its declaring file. Novel commands register through addNovelCommandIfAbsent, so the graph walk misses them and the legacy fallback matches on leaf name alone. Three commands here declare a leaf named add; the fallback picked the generated client-profile 'add <name>' and reported every 'todo add --stdin' recipe as missing a required positional. The fallback's one escape hatch is the <parent>_<leaf>.go basename.
validated_outcome: verify-skill went from 2 severity=error positional-args findings to zero with no change to the command's runtime behavior.
